_note: Synthetic responses shaped like the real Google Books Volumes API (https://www.googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes), used only by `node tools/describe.mjs selftest` to exercise pickGoogleMatch()/cleanDescription() offline. None of this is real book data and none of it is ever written to src/js/data/generated/ — the titles, authors and blurb text below are made up for the test. This exists because the live endpoint 429s from this sandbox's IP (DESCRIPTIONS-FEASIBILITY.md) so the Google Books path cannot be run to completion here, but it still has to be correct before the owner runs it for real with a key.
